topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines the learning objectives for cancer therapy.

topics.label: Conventional Treatments and Clinical Limitations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore conventional cancer treatments and the clinical challenges of systemic toxicity and drug resistance that limit their effectiveness.

topics.label: Targeting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine therapeutic strategies designed to exploit the intrinsic genetic and cellular vulnerabilities of cancer cells.

topics.label: Targeted Kinase Inhibitors and Resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the targeting of oncogenic driver kinases and the molecular mechanisms that lead to acquired drug resistance.

topics.label: Antibody-Based Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the use of engineered monoclonal antibodies to inhibit receptor signalling or deliver cytotoxic agents directly to tumor cells.

topics.label: Immunotherapy and T-Cell Engagement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine tumor immune surveillance and explore immunotherapy strategies that reactivate or engineer T cells to eliminate cancer cells.

topics.label: Progress, Challenges, and Future Perspectives
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the historical progress, ongoing clinical challenges, and future prospects of cancer management.
